<function name="GetDuckSpeed" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns a player's duck speed (in seconds)</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">duckspeed</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Gets player 1's duck speed in seconds, and prints it to console</description>
	<code>print( Entity( 1 ):GetDuckSpeed() )</code>
	<output>0.3 in console (tested)</output>

</example>
